title: Sparkly television
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Antenna -->
  <line x1="42" y1="18" x2="50" y2="28" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="18" x2="50" y2="28" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="17" r="3" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="17" r="3" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x="18" y="28" width="64" height="48" rx="6" fill="#4A90D9"/>
  <rect x="18" y="28" width="64" height="48" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#6BB5FF" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- TV screen -->
  <rect x="24" y="34" width="46" height="34" rx="3" fill="#1A2A4A"/>
  <rect x="24" y="34" width="46" height="34" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#3A5A8A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Screen glow/content - simple image -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="51" r="9" fill="#FFE45C"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="51" r="5" fill="#FFB830"/>
  
  <!-- TV stand -->
  <rect x="38" y="76" width="24" height="5" rx="2" fill="#3A6EA5"/>
  <rect x="32" y="81" width="36" height="4" rx="2" fill="#2E5A8A"/>
  
  <!-- Knobs/buttons on right side -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="40" r="3" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="50" r="3" fill="#7ED957"/>
  <rect x="73" y="58" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#FFD700"/>
  
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Top left sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(12, 22)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-6" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#FFE45C" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="0" x2="6" y2="0" stroke="#FFE45C" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="-4" x2="4" y2="4" stroke="#FFE45C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="4" y1="-4" x2="-4" y2="4" stroke="#FFE45C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Top right sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(88, 24)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#FF9EF5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#FF9EF5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#FF9EF5" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="-3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#FF9EF5" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bottom left sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(10, 70)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#7ED957" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#7ED957" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Bottom right sparkle -->
  <g transform="translate(90, 68)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#FFE45C" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#FFE45C" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Small sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx="14" cy="50" r="2" fill="#FF9EF5"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="82" r="2" fill="#7ED957"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#FFE45C"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#FF9EF5"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#7ED957"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="12" r="2" fill="#FFE45C"/>
</svg>
